annotations.title: WOZ value objection check and OZB property tax

description: Checks whether objecting to a Dutch WOZ value (the municipal home valuation) is worth it: compares the WOZ value with comparable sales by price per m², and shows what a lower value saves a year in eigenwoningforfait (Box 1) and OZB property tax, and the 6-week objection deadline. Without comparable sales it still gives the yearly OZB and how objecting works. Objecting is free; the decision (WOZ-beschikking) says the value and the date.

comparables.description: Comparable homes sold around the valuation date (1 January of the year before the WOZ year): price and living area. Two or more make the comparison usable.

decision_date.description: Date on the WOZ decision, YYYY-MM-DD, for the deadline (optional)

living_area_m2.description: Living area of the home in m² (needed to compare with sales)

ozb_rate_pct.description: OZB owner rate of the municipality, % of the WOZ value (on the tax assessment). Default 0.1.

taxable_income.description: Box 1 taxable income, to work out the tax rate on the eigenwoningforfait. Default: the 37.56% rate.

woz_value.description: WOZ value on the decision, in euros

woz_year.description: The year on the WOZ decision. Default 2026.
